question: Should OpenClaw require deterministic migration for references to the 37 released bundled skills before removal, or intentionally accept an upgrade that requires manual ClawHub recovery?
rationale: Current source and release history establish that shipped capability disappears, but only maintainers can choose the permanent product contract between migration, an intentional compatibility break, or splitting the safe Sherpa work.

options.title: Require deterministic migration
options.body: Add a doctor-owned migration or equivalent in-product recovery for released skill references and prove fresh-install plus upgrade behavior before removal.

options.title: Accept manual recovery
options.body: Approve the capability break explicitly and require clear upgrade evidence and operator-facing recovery instructions for affected users.

options.title: Split the safe subset
options.body: Extract Sherpa packaging and source-aware official installation into a focused PR while leaving the bundle unchanged.

recommendation.title: Require deterministic migration
recommendation.body: Add a doctor-owned migration or equivalent in-product recovery for released skill references and prove fresh-install plus upgrade behavior before removal.

likelyOwner.reason: He maintained the extraction sequence and explicitly owns the remaining bundled-skill/Sherpa decision context in the discussion.
